system.description:
Rank 1: You can activate this Talent on your turn to become enraged. When enraged you gain the following benefits:

  • When you take any damage, gain + 10 to your damage rolls (stackable).
  • Regain 10 aura per turn while enraged.

When you deactivate this talent, you gain exhausted X, where X is 2 times the number of turns you were enraged.

Rank 2: While enraged; whenever you take damage, increase the bonus to your damage rolls by 5.

Rank 3: If you are exhausted because of being enraged, the max complexity of your martial attacks is increased by 2 for those rounds of being exhausted.

Rank 4: While enraged; you regain 5 additional aura per turn you were enraged.

Rank 5: You restore 10 hp every turn you are in combat but not enraged.

Rank 6: While enraged, you can pay the cost of 15 hp to increase your max complexity by 3 for martial attacks.

Rank 7: While enraged, you can pay the cost of 10 percent of your remaining hp to gain one additional melee action.

You can only use this talent once per turn.

Rank 8: While enraged, increase your overland by 1.

Rank 9: While enraged, you roll combat skills with advantage.

Rank 10: While enraged, you can remove 1 value in a condition you are suffering from except being exhausted, during the recovery phase.

Rank 1: You learn One Martial School for using a bite.

When your melee attack or martial art that uses a bite has successfully hit the target(s), add bleed 1.

Rank 2: You learn Two martial arts for using a bite.

If you successfully hit a single target past Tn by 30 by using a bite; while the target has bleed, the target will leave a trail of blood for as long as the target has bleed. When tracking this target effect by this talent, you roll with Advantage.

Rank 3: If you attack a single target with bleed, increase the Tn by 10.

Rank 4: You learn One additional martial art for using a bite.

If you successfully hit the target(s) past Tn by 30 by using a bite, you may add your claw modifier to the damage. This counts as a basic claw attack for any effects.

Rank 5: You learn One additional martial art for using a bite.

If you successfully hit the target(s) by using a bite, you increase the damage by harm 1 while the next melee attack with a bite will have the action cost decrease by 1 to a minimum of 1.

Rank 6: When your martial art that uses a bite has successfully hit the target(s); while the target(s) has any stacks of bleed, you can deal slashing damage equal to the number of stacks of bleed.

Rank 7: You learn One additional martial art for using a bite.

When your melee attack or martial art that uses a bite has successfully hit the target(s), ignore the bleed resistance by 10 or lower.

Rank 8: You learn One additional martial art for using a bite.

If you successfully hit the target(s) past Tn by 30 by using a bite, you recover 10 hp and the target(s) gains broken limb 1.

Rank 9: Your soul art's complexity is decreased by 5 after the school multiplier, to a minimum of 1.

Rank 10: You learn Five additional martial arts for using a bite.

When your melee attack or martial art that uses a bite has successfully hit a single target, you can choose to use your bite to grapple the target. While the target is grappled, the target suffers from the additional following effects:

  • Movement is reduced to 1 square per action. You must follow the target to an adjacent square to continue the grapple.
  • All attacks and spells against the target are rolled with Advantage.
  • The target can attempt to break the grapple once per turn, but is rolled with Disadvantage.
  • The target takes additional slashing damage equal to the number of stacks of bleed at the end of your turn.
  • If you are enraged while using this talent and the target is reduced to 0 hp by this talent, you regain 75 hp.

You can only use this talent once per Scene.

Rank 1: You learn One Martial School for using claws.

When you roll a critical success on your melee attack or martial art that uses claws, add grim wound 1.

Rank 2: You learn Two martial arts for using claws.

When your martial art that uses claws has successfully hit the target(s), deal bonus slashing damage equal to 1/4 your accuracy modifier.

Rank 3: Any melee attacks using claws can be dual-wielded without a penalty.

Rank 4: You learn One additional martial art for using claws.

If you successfully hit the target(s) past Tn by 30 by using claws, you may add your tail to the damage. This counts as a basic tail attack for any effects.

Rank 5: You learn One additional martial art for using claws.

When your melee attack or martial art that uses claws has successfully hit the target(s), you increase the damage by harm 1 while the next melee attack with claws will have the action cost decrease by 1 to a minimum of 1.

Rank 6: When your melee attack or martial art that uses claws has successfully hit the target(s), increase their Defense by 10 and for each successful attack after that. This talent can go up to max of 30 and lasts up to the end of the scene.

Rank 7: You learn One additional martial art for using claws.

At a cost of 10 hp, your melee attacks or martial art that uses claws deal a bonus 10 slashing damage as long your hp is above half. If this talent cost drops below half hp, the additional bonus damage is doubled.

Rank 8: You learn One additional martial art for using claws.

When your melee attack that uses claws has successfully hit a single target, you restore 5 hp.

Rank 9: Your soul art's complexity is decreased by 5 after the school multiplier, to a minimum of 1.

Rank 10: You learn Five additional martial arts for using claws.

You can select a single target you can sense. Until the end of the scene, this target is pursued. You gain the following effects:

  • When tracking the target, you roll with Advantage.
  • Any damage done to the target, Increase by harm 1.
  • Once per turn, an attack or spell against you is rolled with Disadvantage.
  • When your melee attack or martial art that uses claws has successfully hit the target, add 10 additional slashing damage for each successful hit struck when using this talent.
  • If you are enraged while using this talent and the target is reduced to 0 hp by this talent, you regain 75 hp and then choose a new target to pursue.

You can only use this talent once per day.

Rank 1: Your bite, claw and tail count as one natural weapon group. The rank 1-3 effects of your Bite, Claw and Tail Combat talents also apply to all three natural weapons, except the lines that teach martial schools or martial arts. Your first natural weapon attack each turn gains +5 accuracy.

Rank 2: The aura cost of attacks and martial arts that use natural weapons is decreased by 3 for every 5 points of complexity the action has (round down), to a minimum of 1.

Rank 3: When you hit with two different natural weapons in the same turn, the second hit gains harm 1.

Rank 4: The rank 4-6 effects of your Bite, Claw and Tail Combat talents also apply to all three natural weapons, except the lines that teach martial schools or martial arts. Natural weapon attacks against a grappled or prone target gain +10 accuracy.

Rank 5: Once per turn, after you attack with one natural weapon, you may make a basic attack with a different natural weapon for 1 less action, to a minimum of 1.

Rank 6: The aura cost decrease from rank 2 of this talent is changed to 5 for every 5 points of complexity.

Rank 7: The rank 7-9 effects of your Bite, Claw and Tail Combat talents also apply to all three natural weapons, except the lines that teach martial schools or martial arts. The harm from rank 3 of this talent is changed to harm 2.

Rank 8: Once per scene, one natural weapon attack ignores the target's natural armor. This costs no action.

Rank 9: Your soul art's complexity is decreased by 5 after the school multiplier, to a minimum of 1.

Rank 10: The rank 10 effects of your Bite, Claw and Tail Combat talents also apply to all three natural weapons, except the lines that teach martial schools or martial arts. Once per scene, you may make one attack with each of your natural weapons against a single target as a single action.

Rank 1: Increase your Hp by 10, once per scene you can spend aura equal to the damage you are taking to negate the damage.

Rank 2: Any Tn involving your con is increased by 3 and you can spend 5 aura to increase the tn by 1 per 5.

Rank 3: While being at above 50 percent hp you can ignore 1 condition tag once per scene. During the recovery stage you can lower the value of one condition by 1.

Rank 4: Increase your hp by 15, increase your aura regeneration by 1 for every 10 hp you have while above 50 percent hp.

Rank 5: When you are required to make a mental check you can instead make it a con check once per day. If you succeed you may use this ability again this scene.

Rank 6: Gain resistance to Poison, Fire and cold damage equal to your level in this Talent plus your End. You can spend 15 aura to restore 5 resistance you have once per turn besides bleed resistance.

Rank 7: Any Tn involving your End is increased by 3 and increase your max aura by your End.

Rank 8: Increase your hp by 15. When a condition besides bleed is applied to you once per scene you may attempt to auto cure it.

Rank 9: Whenever you take bleed damage you can make a con check on pass you take no bleed damage this turn.

Rank 10: While at above 50 percent hp gain resistance to Blunt, Piercing, and Slashing damage equal to your level in this talent plus your Con.

Rank 1: Increase one Perception skill of your choice by 5. Your passive Perception scores are increased by your level in this talent.

Rank 2: You gain dark vision: within burst 6, you treat light stages 0-2 as light stage 3 for your sight and Perception checks.

Rank 3: Increase another Perception skill by 5. When you pass a Search check, you also learn whether any creature passed through that area in the last hour.

Rank 4: Choose one Perception skill you did not select; it can now be used passively.

Rank 5: Creatures attempting to hide from you have their stealth Tn decreased by your level in this talent. Your dark vision range increases to burst 9.

Rank 6: Increase two Perception skills by 5. You ignore Half Concealment.

Rank 7: When you pass a Trickery Spotting or Examine check against a creature, you also learn one of its resistances or weaknesses.

Rank 8: Blind values applied to you are halved (round down), and you can sense creatures within burst 2 without sight. Your dark vision range increases to burst 12.

Rank 9: Choose another Perception skill you did not select; it can now be used passively. You now have all 8 Perception skills as passive.

Rank 10: You can never be caught in a Stealth Round. Once per scene, as a free action, reveal every hidden creature within burst 10.

Rank 1: You grow a gland that stores mana, holding up to 5 times your level in this talent. It starts each scene empty. Whenever you regain mana while your mana is full, the extra goes into the gland. You can spend stored mana in place of your own when casting a spell.

Rank 2: Whenever you take elemental damage, add mana to your gland equal to half the damage you took after resistance.

Rank 3: When you hit with a bite attack, drain mana from the target equal to your level in this talent and add it to your gland.

Rank 4: Your gland now holds up to 10 times your level in this talent and starts each scene with mana equal to your Int.

Rank 5: As an action you can spit stored mana at a target within range 6, dealing 1d6 damage per 20 mana spent of an elemental type from one of your magic schools.

Rank 6: Spells you pay for entirely with stored mana cost 5 less mana, to a minimum of 1.

Rank 7: While your gland is at least half full, gain Ward 5.

Rank 8: Your mana spit is now a cone 2, and its damage dice become d10.

Rank 9: Whenever you pass a Ward roll, add mana equal to half the spell's mana cost to your gland.

Rank 10: Once per scene, if your gland is full, you may empty it to cast a spell without paying its mana cost.

Rank 1: When you gain this talent, create a poison with a complexity of 10 this increases by 2 each level you have in this talent it can be applied to natural weapons for free or requires a turn to apply to a weapon lasting for 1 attack. It cost 12 aura per application to a weapon.

Rank 2: The poison gains the ability to have its effect modified once per day swapping out one effect for another one of the same complexity cost.

Rank 3: When your poison is used for a natural attack it deals 1d4 more damage.

Rank 4: The Tn to resist your poison is decreased by 5.

Rank 5: Every 6th use of your poison attack in a scene does not cost aura.

Rank 6: gain a tier 2 poison with a complexity of 15 increasing by 3 for each level past this one Cost 24 aura.

Rank 7: The first use of your poison per scene does not cost aura.

Rank 8: While using your poison on a weapon it last for 2 attacks instead of 1.

Rank 9: The free poison from Rank 5 now happens every 5th use instead of every 6th.

Rank 10: Weapons now deal 1d4 more damage and natural weapons deal 1 extra harm.

Rank 1: lower defense by 5, When a melee attack misses you can deal damage to the attacker equal to half your Durability.

Rank 2: Gain natural armor equal to your Con+Lv. This armor regenerates even from zero after 2 rounds of taking no damage.

Rank 3: While having natural armor physical attacks against you that do not roll at least 15 under your defense have their weapon take damage equal to the difference between the roll and your defense. Natural weapons instead go down one die size on the harm chart or lose a die of damage.

Rank 4: Lower defense by 5, gain piercing resistance equal to Str+End.

Rank 5: Any physical resistance you have restores 2 points at the start of each of your turns unless they are fully taken out.

Rank 6: Lower defense by 5. Gain blunt resistance equal to Lv+natural armor.

Rank 7: While having resistance to physical damage decrease your defense by 20 vs that type of damage.

Rank 8: The damage caused by a melee attack is now equal to your Durability.

Rank 9: lower defense by 5, physical damage that you do not resist cause you to gain 5 of that type of physical resistance once per scene per type.

Rank 10: lower defense by 10 increase all physical resistance by 15.

Rank 1: increases movement by 2 and increases your base attack count by 1 for all melee weapons.

Rank 2: When dealing attack count damage, increase the damage by 2 per attack count. For every 3 attack counts that hit, increase this bonus by 2.

Rank 3: Increase your base attack count by 2, when you land 4 or more attack counts you may make a free dodge action.

Rank 4: Increase your overland speed by 2, whenever an enemy makes an attack of opportunity against you. You may roll a speed check on a pass you may use your evasion instead of defense for the attack.

Rank 5: When using the sprint or run action once per scene you can make them cost 1 less action to use. Doing so prevents enemies from making attacks of opportunity.

Rank 6: Increase your base attack count by 1, the trigger per attack is 4 instead of 5.

Rank 7: Increase your overland speed by 2. When running or sprinting increase your movement by 3.

Rank 8: Increase your accuracy by 2 for each attack count this action has.

Rank 9: Decrease your evasion by 10. When a ranged attack misses you, you can make a movement action.

Rank 10: Attack count damage increases by 4 per attack count.

Rank 1: melee damage is increased by half your Str, you count as one size larger when determining max carry capacity and Str checks.

Rank 2: When making a Str check you can roll twice and take the better result once per scene.

Rank 3: Physical resistance your target has takes 10 additional damage that is not reduced.

Rank 4: Your Str counts as 3 for adventure skills and can use it for combat skills thrice per turn.

Rank 5: Melee damage is increased by the aura cost of the martial you use once per turn.

Rank 6: You count your Str as 5 higher when making a Str check and can use it once per scene instead of any other Stat check.

Rank 7: Decrease your defense by your Str vs physical damage.

Rank 8: Physical resistance your target has takes 10 additional damage. This stacks with Rank 3.

Rank 9: Decrease the martial aura cost of the first martial each turn by double your Str. this does not reduce the bonus damage super strength does.

Rank 10: You count as one size larger when using combat or adventure skills, on success on a skill check using Str the next skill check is increased by twice your strength once per scene.

Rank 1: You learn One Martial School for using a tail.

When you hit with a tail attack you may attempt a combat action with a minus 15 to the Tn.

Rank 2: You learn Two martial arts for using a tail.

Your tail gains reach 1.

Rank 3: You can increase the action cost of your next tail attack by 1 to use either your claw or bite attack as a dual wield option.

Rank 4: You learn One additional martial art for using a tail.

Increase your tail harm by 1 when attacking a creature grappled or prone.

Rank 5: You learn One additional martial art for using a tail.

Increase your accuracy by 10 if you use another weapon before attacking with your tail or are dual wielding when attacking.

Rank 6: Your tail can make the trip action as a free action when ever you make an attack of opportunity.

Rank 7: You learn One additional martial art for using a tail.

Increase your tail reach by 1, the minus to combat actions is now 10.

Rank 8: You learn One additional martial art for using a tail.

When attacking a target that has no ally within burst 2 increase your tail harm by 2.

Rank 9: Your soul art's complexity is decreased by 5 after the school multiplier, to a minimum of 1.

Rank 10: You learn Five additional martial arts for using a tail.

When attacking a prone or grappled target, you may once per scene use one of the following effects.

  • The target takes double damage from your tail.
  • They cannot spend their movement on the next turn.
  • Increase all condition values by 1.

Rank 1: Healing you receive from any source is increased by half your Con.

Rank 2: During the Recovery Stage, regain hp equal to your level in this talent.

Rank 3: Increase your Con by 1 and its max by the same.

Rank 4: Your natural armor regenerates an additional amount equal to half your level in this talent.

Rank 5: Once per scene, when you drop below half your hp, gain regeneration equal to your Con (Fire, Acid) for 3 rounds.

Rank 6: Increase your Con by 1 and its max by the same. When you treat a condition during the Recovery Stage, decrease it by 1 more.

Rank 7: Healing you receive from any source is now increased by your full Con.

Rank 8: Increase your max hp by twice your Con.

Rank 9: Increase your Con by 1 and its max by the same.

Rank 10: Once per day, when you would reach 0 hp, you instead stay at 1 hp and heal for 5 times your Con.

Starting materials (Draft): If you take this talent at character creation, you gain 2 Common tier 1 reagents for this craft.

Rank 1: Your max complexity for potions is your rank in this talent x5.

When brewing with 3 or fewer reagents, increase the Tn by 5.

Rank 2: Concocting a potion with 2 or fewer reagents increases the Tn by 10. Once per day, you may treat a regular reagent as an arcane; it counts as having a Sorcery of 4.

Rank 3: You add your Int as a flat bonus to the healing or damage your potions deal.

Rank 4: Brewing a potion with a complexity of 5 or less is an auto pass and its Heal or Harm is doubled.

Rank 5: Reagents whose winning-side values total 1 or less do not count as extra reagents (no +2 complexity) when brewing a potion.

Rank 6: The maximum range of your throw is increased by 1 Square.

Rank 7: You can use 2 arcane ingredients as reagents for brewing potions.

Rank 8: The critical range of your potions are increased to 1-10%.

Rank 9: Increase the Tn by 10 for saves vs being poisoned.

Rank 10: You can brew a potion instantly as a free action at no cost; however, this potion is unstable and will explode, setting off an effect. At the end of your turn, roll a d10 to see what effect the potion will have:

  • 1 - Any targets within a radius of Blast 1 can take an additional action on their turn.
  • 2 - Any targets within a radius of Blast 1 next attack roll is rolled with Disadvantage.
  • 3 - A cloud of magical smoke within a radius of Blast 4 explodes and lasts until the end of your next turn. Any targets within this cloud are considered blinded for the duration inside the cloud.
  • 4 - Any targets within a radius of Blast 2 have advantage on their saves until the end of your next turn.
  • 5 - Any targets within a radius of Blast 2 have disadvantage on their saves until the end of your next turn.
  • 6 - Any targets within a radius of Blast 2 gain Weakness 1 to poison damage until the end of your next turn.
  • 7 - Any targets within a radius of Blast 3 regain 2d10 hp.
  • 8 - Any targets within a radius of Blast 3 take 2d10 poison damage.
  • 9 - Any targets within a radius of Blast 1 become invisible until the end of your next turn.
  • 10 - You may select any result from this table.

You can only use this talent once per Scene.

Rank 1: When you find a magic item and you don't meet the requirements to use it, you may choose to attune to it instead. When you do, you can choose one of the following benefits:

  • Increase One stat of your choice by 1 (stackable) at a maximum of 5 per Stat.
  • Increase your mana or aura regeneration by 1 (Stackable) at a maximum of 10 to either.
  • Decrease the number of days between regaining soul by 1 for each set of 5 magic items attuned this way (stackable) with a maximum of One per week.

Rank 2: Unusable magical items may be broken down to create One rune (up to the maximum size of 5) that you are aware of at the cost of 10 items to make per rune.

Rank 3: Increase the maximum amount of attunement bonus by 5.

Rank 4: You can over enchant 1 item for every 5 unusable magic items you are attuned to with up to ÷3 bonus enchantment.

Rank 5: At the cost of attuned unusable magical item, you gain one benefit:

  • You regain 30 hp per each Tier of the item.
  • You regain 45 mana per each Tier of the item.
  • You regain 60 aura per each Tier of the item.

Rank 6: You gain the ability to increase your hoard value by 20 for each attunement up to a maximum of a value of 300.

Rank 7: Increase your Lair strength by 5 for each magic item you have attuned to.

If your hoard value is above your bounty, Adventurers that come after you will bring 1d4 random level appropriate additional unusable magic items.

Rank 8: Whenever you find a magic item that has ward against you, you may attempt to break it at no cost with an 80 reduction to the Tn.

Rank 9: When battling an enemy carrying a magical item, you can immediately sense what magic that item has.

Rank 10: Before you or an ally make a dice roll, you can choose to boost the roll by sacrificing attuned items you are using. The effect to this roll is changed by the number of items you sacrificed. The effects are:

  • 1 Item: Increase the Tn of that roll by 10.
  • 2 Items: Roll with Advantage.
  • 3 Items: Make the Roll an Automatic Success.

You can only use this talent once per day.

Starting materials (Draft): If you take this talent at character creation, you gain 2 Common tier 1 materials for this craft.

Rank 1: Your max complexity for armor, weapons, tools, and other materials-based equipment is your rank in this talent x5.

When crafting any armor, weapons, tools, and other materials-based equipment, any materials with the same attribute will count as 1 less complexity per material used with a minimum of 1.

Rank 2: All weapons and armor you successfully crafted will contain one engraved slot of size 1 for free.

Rank 3: You add your End/4 to an attribute of your crafted armor, weapons, tools, and other materials-based equipment.

Rank 4: When you craft a weapon or armor while using Tier 1 materials while using 3 or less materials, the weapon or armor will gain one engraved slot of size 2 for free.

Rank 5: You may use materials with a complexity of 1 without it counting towards the total complexity of the item unless it is only made with complexity 1 items or it is twice the number of other materials in total.

Rank 6: Increase the accuracy by 10 when using any weapons crafted by you.

Rank 7: When you craft a weapon or armor while using Tier 1 materials with 1 Tier 2 material, increase one attribute by 3.

Rank 8: When you craft armor, weapons, tools, or other materials-based equipment; increase the critical range of your crafting checks by 2.

Rank 9: Increase the Tn by 10 for saves vs being on fire.

Rank 10: When you or an ally uses a weapon or armor you have made. Depending on the type of item, you gain one of the following effect:

  • Weapon: The attack automatically hits the target(s), but the weapon's harm is decreased by 1 (to a minimum of harm 2).
  • Armor: Reduce any damage taken by half.

You can only use this talent once per turn.

Rank 1: Increase the Tn by 10 whenever you use any social skills that use deception.

Rank 2: Whenever you succeed in a social skill roll by using deception against a single target past Tn by 30, the target is convinced to do one simple task that takes 1 round. The task is subject to Game Master's discretion. Example: the target won't harm themselves or attempt to do anything they know they can't do.

Rank 3: When any target(s) have failed their perception save against your social skill rolls that use deception, any future failed rolls the target(s) make against your deceptions will decrease the Tn by 10 for each failure. This can go up to max of 30 within a 24 hour period.

Rank 4: Whenever you succeed in a social skill roll by using deception against a single target past Tn by 30, you don't require any additional rolls for the next 5 rounds. However, the deception must be within logical reasons and subject to Game Master's discretion. Example: The target won't believe that a beggar on the street is secretly the king of a country.

Rank 5: Whenever you fail a social skill roll by using deception against the target(s) Tn by up to 10, you can reroll again for free.

You can only use this talent once per Scene.

Rank 6: Whenever you succeed in a social skill roll by using deception against a single target, that target can't use any social skill rolls against you while using deception for the rest of the Scene.

Rank 7: Whenever you succeed in a social skill roll by using deception against targets within a city of 1 hex, any future deception rolls against those targets will Increase the Tn by 10 for 24 hours.

Rank 8: Whenever you succeed in a social skill roll by using deception against a single target; within the next 2 rounds, your next weapon attack or spell against the target can be rolled with Advantage. If the target is hit, the effects of deception are negated.

You can only use this talent once per Scene.

Rank 9: Increase the Tn by 10 for whenever you use a perception skill against any deception.

Rank 10: In combat, you can attempt to use a social roll against a single target with the deception being that another target, within range of 10 squares, is an enemy. The target will be enraged against the other chosen target for X turns, where X is equal to 1 per 10 you passed the Tn by.

You can only use this talent once per day.

Starting materials (Draft): If you take this talent at character creation, you gain 2 Common tier 1 materials for this craft.

Rank 1: You gain the ability to create and command 1 Golem, Homunculus, or any other type of Construct (Golems, Homunculi, or any other type of Constructs are considered minions when applying leadership talents). However, Golems, Homunculi, or any other type of Constructs are different than minions in these ways:

  • They are completely loyal and don't require morale checks to obey commands.
  • They have no will of their own. Once they complete a command, they will stand still and wait for the next command to follow. If no command is made within 24 hours of standing still, the construct will return back to your lair.
  • They can't regain hp the usual way. They can regain hp through repairs.

Golems, Homunculi, or any other type of Constructs don't count towards the max number of minions you can command.

Rank 2: You can now create and control up to 4 Homunculi.

You can put up to 4 Homunculi you control in a throwable bottle. Once thrown, wherever the bottle lands will release any Homunculi inside the bottle at a blast 2 (including occupied spaces). Any enemy target(s) within this blast radius must make a save vs being feared with a decrease to the Tn by 10.

Rank 3: All ranged or melee weapon attacks targeted at you will be redirected to an adjacent Golem, Homunculus, or any other type of Construct you control instead.

Rank 4: You can now create and control up to 2 Golems.

Whenever a Golem you control has successfully hit target(s) with an attack, the target(s) must make a save vs being taunted with a decrease to the Tn by 10. If the throw fails, the target(s) gains 1 taunted (stackable).

Rank 5: You can now create and control up to 2 Constructs that aren't Golems or Homunculi.

You can equip 1 of these Constructs you control with upgrades. Turrets use the Construct's stats with the weapon damage listed in the Construct upgrades table. Whenever a Construct's ranged attack with a turret has successfully hit the target(s), the target(s) is pushed back by 1 square.

Rank 6: All martial arts or spells targeted at you will be redirected to an adjacent Golem, Homunculus, or any other type of Construct you control instead.

Rank 7: You can now create and control up to 6 Homunculi.

Homunculi you control gain the ability to throw slime at a single target. Whenever a Homunculus you control has successfully hit a target with a slime throw, the target must make a save vs being blinded with a decrease to the Tn by 10. If the throw fails, the target gains 1 blinded (stackable). Whenever an ally successfully hits this blinded target with a weapon attack, the ally regains mana or aura up to half of the damage dealt (round down).

Rank 8: You can now create and control up to 3 Golems.

You can create a Golem's Heart and place it inside a Golem you control. You can fill this heart with life force at a cost up to a max of 50 mana (refillable). Whenever a Golem with a heart takes any damage, all allies within burst 3 can regain hp equal to the damage taken up to the remaining life force inside the heart.

You can only create up to 1 Golem's heart at a time.

Rank 9: Whenever a Golem, Homunculus, or any other type of Construct you control takes any damage, the damage is reduced by half.

You can only use this talent once per turn.

Rank 10: You can command a Golem, Homunculus, or any other type of Construct you control to run to a targeted location within sight. It will run to the location and explode, any target(s) within a range of Blast 3 of the explosion will take force damage equal to the remaining hp of the chosen Golem, Homunculus, or any other type of Construct.

You can only use this talent once per turn.
